name: Kisaragi Miyako
source:
A nurse who, like Sayaka and Saeko, ends up working at “Date Clinic.” She has the longest nursing career of the three and is considered a veteran. 

Due to her overly eye-catching figure, she is constantly subjected to inappropriate behavior by patients.

After the protagonist catches her masturbating following an incident, he confronts her about it, leading them to become involved. She ends up becoming a "comfort nurse".

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/9184/?gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
